chunks.text: Task Code: BA431. Screen Name: Customer Profile Definition. Menu Path: Main Menu > Customer Management > Customer Profile. Prerequisites: ST001, ST002. Modes: New, Inquiry, Modify.
BA431 Customer Profile Definition fields: Customer ID is the unique customer identifier; Customer Name is the full name; Customer Type classifies the profile; Short Name is the compact lookup label.
BA431 procedure for creating a customer profile: Open Customer Profile Definition. Choose New mode and enter required fields. Save the profile and confirm the generated Customer ID.
BA431 related screens are Customer Search and Customer Address. A profile cannot be saved until Customer ID, Customer Name, and Customer Type are present.
Task Code: BA435. Screen Name: Account Maintenance Definition. Menu Path: Main Menu > Account Services > Account Maintenance. Prerequisites: BA431. Modes: Inquiry, Modify, Authorize.

BA435 Account Maintenance Definition fields: Account Number identifies the selected account; Customer ID links its owner; Product Code identifies product rules; Account Status shows whether servicing changes are allowed.
BA435 warning: Modify mode changes take effect only after an authorized user approves the record.
BA435 related screens are Customer Profile Definition and Account Authorization.
Task Code: BA436. Screen Name: Service Request Definition. Menu Path: Main Menu > Servicing > Service Request. Prerequisites: BA435. Modes: Inquiry, Create, Close.
BA436 Service Request Definition fields: Request Number is the generated reference; Account Number identifies the account; Request Type classifies the action; Request Status tracks completion.
BA436 note: Close mode is available only when the request has no pending approval.
BA436 related screens are Account Maintenance Definition and Request History.
